baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ... إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The maqālīd are a custody-and-access system spanning the upper and lower domains: one holder preserves what lies within, opens it, and knows the whole field over which access operates.

activation_trace.role: A preserving and opening implement supplies the literal access image and makes maqālīd the controlling interface of the mechanism.
What is above and overshadows supplies the upper domain whose contents fall under that access.
The lower realm opposite the sky completes the vertical totality governed by the maqālīd.
Complete disclosure to the knower makes access informed rather than merely possessive.

changed_reading.before: God owns keys and varies provision.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents a single, comprehensively informed custody system for opening, preserving, and withholding across both cosmic domains.

baseline_models.mechanism: Provision is an allotted benefit whose breadth is adjustable. Will selects its recipient, while qadr supplies both a set amount and the possibility of narrowing it; knowledge closes the allocation loop.

activation_trace.role: Breadth, increase, and surplus supply the adjustable expansion side of allocation.
An apportioned gift supplies the object being distributed rather than an undifferentiated stock.
Will attached to a thing supplies recipient-sensitive selection within the distribution.
A quantity brought to its limit supplies the measured scale of each share.
Narrowing something to a small measure supplies the active counter-movement to expansion.

changed_reading.before: Expansion means generosity and restriction means scarcity.
changed_reading.after: Expansion and constriction are two settings of a measured, recipient-specific allocation rather than morally opposed acts.

baseline_models.mechanism: A focus-only ecological branch combines the maqālīd as water shares or recurring irrigation turns, provision as rain, spreading as spatial release, and qadr as measured timing or amount.

activation_trace.role: A land's water share or recurring irrigation turn supplies a timed-release sense for maqālīd.
Spreading and extension supply the movement of released water across a receiving surface.
Rain named as life-producing provision supplies the ecological substance being released.
A bounded quantity supplies the scheduled amount of the release.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns a general alternation of abundance and scarcity.
changed_reading.after: It can also picture timed and measured life-support release, like water shares distributed across land.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding protector, guardian, and agent contrasts specify the ownership claim: the maqālīd are not an office independently held by rival protectors or by the messenger. Custody and operative agency remain with their one holder.

activation_trace.role: The preserving and opening implement anchors the delta in the focus ayah's access-custody image.
Guarding and watchful preservation supply the custody function attributed to God.
An agent who sufficiently manages and preserves an affair supplies the role explicitly denied to the messenger.
Taking charge of an affair turns the rival-versus-true-protector contrast into a question of who actually administers access.

structural_cues: 42:6 pairs God as guardian with the denial that the addressee is their agent.
42:9 contrasts adopted protectors with God as the protector.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit custody and agency contrasts; I infer that they specify what ownership of the maqālīd excludes: no rival or messenger independently controls access. A live alternative is that these are adjacent role limits without lexical force on maqālīd.

changed_reading.after: They signify nondelegable custody and administration: other protectors are ineffective, and even the messenger is not an independent access agent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated provision-by-will formula is enclosed by hidden fineness and concentrated strength. This changes measured distribution from a coarse quantity decision into a precise operation whose rationale can remain below the recipient's perception while still being fully executable.

activation_trace.role: A quantity brought to its limit anchors the focus ayah's calibrated distribution.
Fineness, minuteness, and hiddenness supply the unseen granularity of the allocation.
The apportioned gift repeats the focus object and carries the fine-grained mode into provision itself.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies reliable execution of the subtle allocation.

structural_cues: 42:19 places the same 'provides whom He wills' formula between subtle care toward servants and strength.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the enclosure of provision by fineness and strength; I infer that these describe how the distribution operates. Alternatively, they may be independent divine attributes rather than modifiers of the provision mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The measured share is an overt quantity assigned by will.
changed_reading.after: The share is also a fine-grained and possibly hidden fit to the recipient, backed by sufficient force to bring it about.

context_deltas.mechanism: Increase remains available, but 42:27 gives unrestricted expansion a social failure mode: boundary-crossing aggression. Provision is therefore delivered downward in measured amounts by one acquainted with recipients' interior condition. Constriction becomes regulation against destructive oversupply.

activation_trace.role: Active narrowing anchors the focus ayah's apparently negative pole and makes it available for causal revision.
Growth and increase establish that the mechanism is not simple refusal of abundance.
Breadth and surplus repeat the focus expansion setting in an explicit counterfactual.
Transgressing limits through aggression supplies the stated failure produced by unbounded expansion.
Delivering something downward supplies a controlled-release path rather than an undirected abundance.
A quantity bounded at its limit supplies the dosage of the controlled release.
Knowledge of inward conditions supplies the feedback used to set that dosage.

structural_cues: 42:26 promises increase from bounty immediately before 42:27 limits indiscriminate expansion.
42:27 explicitly states the counterfactual consequence of universal expansion, then replaces it with measured descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the oversupply-to-transgression consequence and the measured alternative; I infer a prophylactic arrow from informed measurement to social restraint. A live alternative is that the verse explains only worldly resource limits, not every instance of withholding.

changed_reading.before: Constriction is merely the negative opposite of generous expansion.
changed_reading.after: Constriction and measurement form a protective throttle: limitless expansion would feed transgression, so provision is released in informed amounts while increase remains possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus-only water-turn branch becomes operational across 42:27-28: provision descends by measure, then rain descends after despair and mercy is spread. The maqālīd can carry a timed hydraulic-release image in which measured withholding and renewed distribution regenerate land and life.

activation_trace.role: A recurring irrigation turn or land's water share anchors the timed-release reading in maqālīd itself.
Rain as life-producing provision supplies the substance released through that schedule.
Delivery downward supplies the vertical path from held source to receiving realm.
A bounded amount supplies the measured volume or timing of descent.
Life-giving rain descending from the sky makes the ecological substance explicit.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the horizontal distribution that follows descent.
Tender mercy identifies the spread release as restorative rather than merely mechanical.

structural_cues: 42:27's measured descent is followed immediately by 42:28's rain after despair and spreading mercy.
The sequence moves from vertical delivery to horizontal spreading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured descent, rain, and spreading mercy; I infer that these activate the water-turn branch of maqālīd as a concrete release cycle. The alternative is that hydrology is only an analogy and should not replace the ordinary key image.

changed_reading.before: The water-turn branch is an isolated lexical curiosity in the focus inventory.
changed_reading.after: The surah turns it into a coherent cycle: held provision descends in measure, rain arrives at the needed turn, and mercy spreads across the receiving domain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late reprise of ownership over heavens and earth moves from creation and gift to daughters, sons, both, or sterility, then closes with knowledge and power. These are differentiated generative outcomes under the same will-and-measure architecture, extending rizq beyond commodity quantity into capacities and life configurations.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned gift anchors the focus object broadly enough to test non-commodity forms of provision.
A bounded measure anchors the differentiation of possible outcomes.
Possession with power of disposal restates the ownership frame within which outcomes are assigned.
Estimating and proportioning a thing supplies the design stage of generative allocation.
Giving without exchange makes the reproductive outcomes gifts rather than earned inventory.
Joining one thing as a counterpart to another supplies the combined-outcome branch of the matrix.
Sterility in womb and offspring supplies a closed generative outcome without reducing it to monetary lack.
Complete knowledge repeats the focus criterion governing differentiated outcomes.
Effective power supplies the capacity to realize each measured configuration.

structural_cues: 42:49 repeats ownership of the heavens and earth and repeats will three times.
42:50 closes the outcome list with the same knowledge-power pairing that closes 42:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a formal reprise of ownership, will, knowledge, and power around reproductive outcomes; I infer that the list concretizes the focus ayah's allocation architecture. A live alternative is that it illustrates creation generally without specifying rizq.

changed_reading.before: Provision varies mainly by material quantity.
changed_reading.after: Provision can include the measured configuration of generative possibility itself: distinct gifts, combinations, and closures under informed will.

context_deltas.mechanism: The one who knows every thing does not expose all knowledge indiscriminately. Communication arrives through hidden casting, a barrier, or a messenger; the delivered content becomes light and a path. The maqālīd thus support an epistemic access-control reading in which knowledge itself is released through measured channels.

activation_trace.role: The preserving and opening implement anchors controlled access in the focus ayah.
Complete disclosure to the knower supplies the total knowledge held behind the access boundary.
Knowledge cast in concealment supplies a low-visibility channel for selective disclosure.
A screening barrier supplies an explicit access boundary between source and recipient.
Messenger and message supply a delegated transmission channel without transferring ownership of the source.
Illumination supplies the usable effect of the released knowledge.
A straight traversable path supplies the directed conduct enabled by that illumination.

structural_cues: 42:51 enumerates exclusive modes of divine-human communication rather than unrestricted disclosure.
42:52 says the recipient did not know the Book or faith before the revealed spirit was made light and guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total divine knowledge, bounded communication modes, and the transformation of revelation into light and path; I infer that maqālīd can govern epistemic as well as material access. The alternative is that the communication passage is a separate closing topic and does not reactivate the key image.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge at the end of 42:12 merely guarantees correct material distribution.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge can itself be provision under access control: wholly possessed at the source, selectively transmitted through veil or messenger, and released as light for a path.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports a transport-control analogy rather than a direct gloss of rizq. It remains anchored in the focus ayah's opening, spreading, and constricting mechanism, while 42:32-33 visibly toggles maritime motion by will. Downstream prose should label it a systems analogy for circulation, not equate provision with shipping.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَقَالِيدُ ... يَبْسُطُ ... وَيَقْدِرُ as opening and regulating a domain-wide flow

activation_trace.role: The preserving and opening implement supplies the control interface for the exploratory flow model.
Spreading and extension supply the active-flow state.
Narrowing supplies the reduced-flow state.
Continuous running or coursing supplies the visible circulation of ships.
Removal of motion supplies the explicit off-state of the transport system.
Wind and moving air supply the medium whose release or arrest controls circulation.
Rest after motion supplies the resulting stalled state.

changed_reading.before: Expansion and constriction alter only the amount possessed by a recipient.
changed_reading.after: They may also describe regulation of circulation and mobility: provision reaches recipients through flows that can be driven, narrowed, or stopped.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates maqālīd's branch of imposed office or obligation and links it to communal consultation. It remains anchored through the focus ayah's allotted provision and 42:38's direct movement from shared affairs to spending that provision. Downstream prose should present it as an entrusted-stewardship possibility, not as a claim that divine keys are transferred to the community.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَقَالِيدُ as entrusted obligation and ٱلرِّزْقَ as an allotted benefit

activation_trace.role: Placing an office or obligation around someone's neck supplies the entrusted-mandate image without transferring ultimate ownership.
An apportioned benefit supplies what the entrusted recipients receive and then handle.
Extracting judgment through mutual review supplies the communal decision process for handling affairs.
The allotted gift repeats the focus object at the point where recipients become stewards of it.
Money leaving through expenditure supplies outward circulation instead of terminal possession.

changed_reading.before: Provision terminates in the individual recipient selected by divine will.
changed_reading.after: A received share can become an entrusted social flow: deliberated as a communal affair and released onward through expenditure.

strongest_changes: 42:27 turns qadr from bare scarcity into informed protective throttling against the transgression predicted by limitless expansion.
42:27-28 activates the focus-only water-turn branch as measured descent, rain after despair, and horizontally spreading mercy.
42:49-50 extends provision from commodity quantity to differentiated generative gifts, combinations, and closures.
42:51-52 opens an epistemic model in which total knowledge is selectively released through bounded channels as light and guidance.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly restaged the focus architecture of ownership, will, measure, and knowledge in social, hydrologic, generative, transport, and revelatory mechanisms; those recurrences changed the focus more than isolated thematic parallels did.
remaining_uncertainties: The water-share branch of maqālīd is tightly activated by 42:27-28, but it may remain a controlled analogy rather than a semantic coloring of the plural noun.
The maritime flow model is mechanically coherent but more cross-domain than the retained causal deltas.
The reproductive outcome list strongly repeats the focus frame, though it may parallel provision rather than instantiate rizq directly.
